image_description: A close-up, slightly low-angle shot of an orangutan behind a chain-link fence. The orangutan has reddish-brown fur and is looking towards the camera with one eye clearly visible. Its left arm is raised, gripping the fence or hanging above, while its right hand is near its chest/face area. The background shows blurred green foliage through the fence mesh.
